answer: Identity is a gin botanical: one juniper berry carries the spirit, and a profile tasting of everything tastes of nothing - keep one defining note, let the rest support it. Value passes the saffron test: true stigmas release color slowly, over minutes, while dyed silk flashes yellow at once - any claim flaring instantly is costume. Standing grows like an orchard: years from planting to bearing, and a farm promising a full orchard by Friday sells saplings as fruit. Water test, single berry, slow orchard - three clocks no shortcut beats. Honest agents steep, define, wait; farms dye, blend, hurry.
